note: Maldives: an expatriate resides and works on a Work Visa, an e-Visa applied for through the Xpat Online System; since 23 November 2025 only an approved e-Visa is a valid Work Visa, a new arrival entering on an Entry Pass (Work Permit). No performers' route or exemption was found, so the Work Visa is the route and no days are modelled. Read on Maldives Immigration's own page.

sources.title: Maldives Immigration, Work Visa Service
sources.said: A Work Visa authorizes expatriates to reside and work in the Maldives. ... All Work Visa applications must be submitted through the Xpat Online System.
